title: "On Stranger Tides" Next Pirates of the Caribbean Title
content: Since theannouncementat Friday's D23 Expo, speculation has begun about the next installment of the Disney Pirates of the Caribbean franchise. The title for the summer 2011 movie will be "Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides." The title comes from the Tim Powers novel for which I did the cover of the skeleton pirate.------More at the blog "Coming Soon"The behind-the-scenes story on GurneyJourney of themaking of that painting.The artwork will be featured in a large reproduction in the soon-to-be-releasedImaginative Realism. At the samestore siteyou can order a signed copy of the collectors edition of the book, which has just become a lot more collectible.
